name: Bin Zero
tagline: Shrink your bin, one swap at a time
about: Bin Zero audits what you throw away, finds the swaps that actually pay off, tells you how to dispose of the awkward stuff and plans package-free shopping trips that fit your week.
persona: You are a practical zero-waste coach: budget-aware, allergic to guilt trips and eco-gadgets, focused on the few changes that remove the most waste for this household.

onboarding.title: Less in the bin, less to buy
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your household and we'll start with the biggest wins.

profile.label: Local services
profile.placeholder: kerbside recycling, no food-waste collection, refill shop nearby

tools.title: Audit my bin
tools.subtitle: Photo of a day's rubbish → what to divert

inputs.label: Photo of your bin or a day's rubbish
inputs.placeholder: Tip a bag out on newspaper first

tools.prompt: This is the {bin} bin. Identify every visible item as a table (Item | Should go in | Could be avoided by | Effort). Then bullets naming the 3 biggest waste streams by volume, a checklist of swaps to try this week ordered by impact, and a callout on anything contaminating the recycling.

tools.title: Is this swap worth it?
tools.subtitle: Cost, payback and whether it lasts

inputs.label: What you spend now per month

tools.prompt: Evaluate the swap '{swap}' against current spend of {spend} per month: kv (upfront cost range, monthly cost after, payback in months, waste avoided per year, verdict), bullets on what people get wrong when they try it, and a callout on when the swap is NOT worth it (e.g. it sits unused).

tools.title: What do I do with this?
tools.subtitle: Reuse, recycle or safe disposal

inputs.label: Item
inputs.placeholder: old duvet, broken hair dryer, expired medicines

tools.prompt: For '{item}' given the local services in the profile: steps for the best route in order (reuse → donate → recycle → dispose), kv (kerbside?, drop-off type, prep needed, hazard notes), and a callout on what must NOT go in household bins.

tools.title: Package-free shop
tools.subtitle: Plan a refill or bulk run

inputs.label: Shopping list
inputs.placeholder: oats, olive oil, washing-up liquid, rice…

tools.prompt: Plan a low-packaging shop for: {list}, shopping at {where}. Table (Item | Best low-waste option | Container to bring | Fallback if unavailable), a checklist of containers and bags to pack, and bullets on storing bulk buys so nothing spoils.

tools.title: Zero-waste room reset
tools.subtitle: Kitchen, bathroom, cleaning or laundry
tools.prompt: A zero-waste reset for the {room} for this household: cards for the 5 highest-impact swaps (meta = cost · payback · effort), a checklist for the 'use up what you have first' phase, and a callout on greenwashed products to skip.

disclaimer: General guidance only; batteries, chemicals, medicines and electricals are hazardous waste — follow your local council or pharmacy rules and never put them in household bins.
